low_body_description: A compact succession of low open curved bodies follows the initial directly, then the terminal curved/descending sign. No separate round body comparable to the post-initial circles in same-line qo controls is visible.
comparison_notes: Target is the fourth group in the second complete baseline of the fixed crop, between shey and chol. Its initial has a low crossbar/head and descending stem compatible with the q-like initials of the registered later controls. G008 and G012 show a separate rounded body immediately after their initial and before the following taller or other body; target does not. The left and right target gaps are visible against tighter internal construction.
limits: Informed relative shape judgment only; not proof of atomic q/e/o identity, count, sound or meaning. Image appearance cannot distinguish deliberate convention from omission or scribal error.
